scripts.start:apphosting: npm run build:shared && ng build --configuration production && node server.mjs
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && npm run build:shared && ng build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:functions && ng build
scripts.ports:kill: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ports=@(4000,4200,4400,5001,8080,8086,9099); foreach($p in $ports){ $conns=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($conns){ $processIds = $conns | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique | Where-Object { $_ -gt 0 }; foreach($processId in $processIds){ try { Stop-Process -Id $processId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output ('Killed process ' + $processId + ' on port ' + $p) } catch { Write-Output ('Failed to kill process ' + $processId + ' on port ' + $p) } } } else { Write-Output ('No process found on port ' + $p) } }"
scripts.preemulators:start: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "try { if(!(Test-Path .firebase\emulator-data)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path .firebase\emulator-data | Out-Null }; $ports=@(4000,4200,4400,5001,8080,8086,9099); foreach($p in $ports){ $conns=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($conns){ $pids = $conns | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique | Where-Object { $_ -gt 0 }; foreach($pid in $pids){ try { Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} } } } ; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; exit 0 } catch { exit 0 }"
scripts.emulators:start: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:start --only auth,functions,firestore,pubsub --import=.firebase/emulator-data --export-on-exit
scripts.emulators:stop: npm run emulators:export && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$exportDir='.firebase\emulator-data'; $hubUp = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4400 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if($hubUp){ Write-Output 'Emulator Hub detected on 4400. Attempting export via Hub REST...'; $exportOk=$false; $attempt=1; $max=2; while(-not $exportOk -and $attempt -le $max){ try { $body = @{ path = $exportDir } | ConvertTo-Json; $resp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:4400/_admin/export' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 15; if($resp){ Write-Output 'Export succeeded.'; $exportOk=$true } } catch { Write-Output ('Export attempt ' + $attempt + ' failed via Hub REST; retrying...') } $attempt++ } if(-not $exportOk){ Write-Output 'Export failed after retries; proceeding to stop.' } } else { Write-Output 'Emulator Hub not detected on 4400; skipping export.' } ; $ports=@(4000,4200,4400,5001,8080,8086,9099); foreach($p in $ports){ $conns=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($conns){ ($conns | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique | Where-Object { $_ -gt 0 }) | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output ('Killed PID ' + $_ + ' on ' + $p) } catch { Write-Output ('Failed to kill PID ' + $_ + ' on ' + $p) } } } else { Write-Output ('No process on ' + $p) } }"
scripts.emulators:stop:fast: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ports=@(4000,4200,4400,5001,8080,8086,9099); foreach($p in $ports){ $conns=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($conns){ ($conns | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique | Where-Object { $_ -gt 0 }) | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output ('Killed PID ' + $_ + ' on ' + $p) } catch { Write-Output ('Failed to kill PID ' + $_ + ' on ' + $p) } } } else { Write-Output ('No process on ' + $p) } }"
scripts.emulators:restart: npm run emulators:stop && npm run emulators:start
